rooms.name: The Desk
rooms.description: Your new desk — a dormant golem, scattered documents, and a blinking message
rooms.unlock_text: You sit at the architect's desk.

rooms.name: The Drafting Hall
rooms.description: Drafting tables, a client screen, and a scroll frame waiting for structured specs
rooms.unlock_text: You enter the Drafting Hall. Blueprints cover every surface.

rooms.name: The Golem Workshop
rooms.description: Circular chamber — the golem sits connected to conduit pipes, document shelves line the walls
rooms.unlock_text: The specs are done. Time to configure the golem.

rooms.name: The Build Yard
rooms.description: Open construction yard — the golem glows blue, a blueprint frame shows architecture layers
rooms.unlock_text: The golem awakens. The Build Yard doors open.

rooms.name: The Launch Tower
rooms.description: Top floor — panoramic window, deployment console, and the golem at the controls
rooms.unlock_text: The elevator rises to the Launch Tower.
